direction: Continual learning on a sequence of permuted-pixel and split-class tasks built from scikit-learn digits: naive fine-tuning versus elastic weight consolidation versus a small experience-replay buffer versus joint training (upper bound). Measure average accuracy and forgetting after each task, and how replay buffer size compares with EWC's regularisation strength.

decisions.decision: Seeds: main 0-4, sweeps 10-14, lr tuning 100-101; lambda* from validation accuracy of sweep seeds; grad clip 5 for all systems because large-lambda EWC diverged to NaN with plain SGD
lr=0.1 chosen on val (seeds 100,101) from tune_lr; used by all systems
lambda* from sweep val_average_accuracy (seeds 10-14): perm_dil 10, split_cil 1000, split_til 1000; ER M=20 and M=100 fixed a priori
